```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo schedule install | remove | status` — the background worker.
// Windows: a per-user Task Scheduler task (no admin) running `memo cycle` every
// config.intervalMinutes, at logon, and as soon as possible after a missed run (sleep, shutdown).
// It runs only while you are logged on; nothing runs while the machine is off or asleep.
// Other platforms: print the cron line instead of installing anything.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');
const { memoBin, memoHome } = require('./paths');
const config = require('./config');

const TASK_NAME = 'MEMO Background Processor';

function scriptsDir() {
  return path.join(__dirname, '..', 'scripts', 'windows');
}

function ps(args, { timeout = 60000 } = {}) {
  const res = spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', ...args], {
    encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, timeout
  });
  return {
    ok: !res.error && res.status === 0,
    out: String(res.stdout || '').trim(),
    err: res.error ? res.error.message : String(res.stderr || '').trim()
  };
}

function taskName() {
  return process.env.MEMO_TASK_NAME || TASK_NAME;
}

// Registers or updates the task (never a duplicate) and removes the pre-installer "worker.cmd" task.
function install({ intervalMinutes = config.load().intervalMinutes } = {}) {
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') {
    return {
      ok: false, unsupported: true,
      detail: 'automatic scheduling is Windows-only in V1. Add this to `crontab -e`:\n  */' +
        intervalMinutes + ' * * * * "' + process.execPath + '" "' + path.resolve(memoBin()) + '" cycle --quiet'
    };
  }
  const res = ps(['-File', path.join(scriptsDir(), 'register-task.ps1'),
    '-NodeExe', process.execPath, '-MemoJs', path.resolve(memoBin()), '-TaskName', taskName(),
    '-IntervalMinutes', String(intervalMinutes), '-RemoveLegacy', '-BackupDir', path.join(memoHome(), 'backup')]);
  return { ok: res.ok, detail: res.ok ? res.out : (res.out + '\n' + res.err).trim() };
}

function remove() {
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') return { ok: true, detail: 'nothing to remove (remove the cron line by hand if you added one)' };
  const res = ps(['-File', path.join(scriptsDir(), 'register-task.ps1'),
    '-NodeExe', process.execPath, '-MemoJs', path.resolve(memoBin()), '-TaskName', taskName(), '-Remove', '-RemoveLegacy',
    '-BackupDir', path.join(memoHome(), 'backup')]);
  return { ok: res.ok, detail: res.ok ? res.out : (res.out + '\n' + res.err).trim() };
}

const INFO_PS = [
  '$t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $args[0] -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;',
  'if (-not $t) { "{}" ; exit 0 }',
  '$i = $t | Get-ScheduledTaskInfo;',
  '$a = ($t.Actions | Select-Object -First 1);',
  '$fmt = { param($d) if ($d -and $d.Year -gt 2000) { $d.ToString("o") } else { $null } };',
  '[pscustomobject]@{ exists = $true; state = [string]$t.State; lastRun = (& $fmt $i.LastRunTime);',
  '  nextRun = (& $fmt $i.NextRunTime); lastResult = [int64]$i.LastTaskResult; missedRuns = [int]$i.NumberOfMissedRuns;',
  '  action = ([string]$a.Execute + " " + [string]$a.Arguments) } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress'
].join(' ');

/**
 * Task Scheduler's own view of the task.
 * @returns {{supported, exists, state?, lastRun?, nextRun?, lastResult?, action?, pointsHere?}}
 */
function info() {
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') return { supported: false, exists: false };
  if (process.env.MEMO_FAKE_TASK) {
    try { return { supported: true, ...JSON.parse(process.env.MEMO_FAKE_TASK) }; } catch (_) { /* fall through */ }
  }
  const res = ps(['-Command', '& {' + INFO_PS + '}', taskName()], { timeout: 30000 });
  let parsed = {};
  try { parsed = res.out ? JSON.parse(res.out) : {}; } catch (_) { parsed = {}; }
  const out = { supported: true, exists: Boolean(parsed.exists), ...parsed };
  if (out.action) out.pointsHere = out.action.toLowerCase().includes(path.resolve(memoBin()).toLowerCase());
  return out;
}

// 0 = success, 0x41301 = currently running, 0x41303 = has not run yet.
function resultText(code) {
  if (code === undefined || code === null) return 'unknown';
  const known = { 0: 'success', 267009: 'running now', 267011: 'not run yet', 3221225786: 'interrupted (Ctrl+C / logoff)' };
  return known[code] || '0x' + Number(code).toString(16);
}

function command(argv = []) {
  const sub = argv[0] || 'status';
  if (sub === 'install') {
    const res = install();
    process.stdout.write(res.detail + '\n');
    if (!res.ok && !res.unsupported) process.exitCode = 1;
    return res;
  }
  if (sub === 'remove') {
    const res = remove();
    process.stdout.write(res.detail + '\n');
    if (!res.ok) process.exitCode = 1;
    return res;
  }
  if (sub !== 'status') {
    process.stderr.write('usage: memo schedule [status | install | remove]\n');
    process.exitCode = 1;
    return null;
  }
  const i = info();
  if (!i.supported) process.stdout.write('not Windows — run `memo schedule install` for the cron line\n');
  else if (!i.exists) process.stdout.write('task "' + taskName() + '" not registered — run `memo schedule install`\n');
  else {
    process.stdout.write([
      'task       ' + taskName() + ' (' + i.state + ')',
      'last run   ' + (i.lastRun ? i.lastRun.slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ') : 'never') + ' → ' + resultText(i.lastResult),
      'next run   ' + (i.nextRun ? i.nextRun.slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ') : '—'),
      'runs       ' + (i.pointsHere ? 'this MEMO install' : 'ANOTHER path: ' + i.action + ' — run `memo schedule install`')
    ].join('\n') + '\n');
  }
  return i;
}

function hasFile(p) {
  try { return fs.existsSync(p); } catch (_) { return false; }
}

module.exports = { TASK_NAME, taskName, install, remove, info, resultText, command, scriptsDir, hasFile };
```

```ps1
#Requires -Version 5.1
<#
  Registers (or updates) the MEMO scheduled task for the current user. No admin rights needed.
  The task runs `node bin/memo.js cycle` every -IntervalMinutes, once at logon, and as soon as
  possible after a run was missed (machine asleep or off). It only runs while you are logged on.

  Hidden launch: by default the action is wscript.exe run-hidden.vbs, which starts node with no
  console window and waits for it, so Task Scheduler sees the real run time and result.
  -HiddenMethod direct runs node.exe itself (a console window may flash).

  -RemoveLegacy also removes tasks from before the installer existed: any task whose action
  runs %USERPROFILE%\.memo\worker.cmd. Their definition is exported to -BackupDir first.
#>
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$NodeExe,
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$MemoJs,
  [string]$TaskName = 'MEMO Background Processor',
  [int]$IntervalMinutes = 15,
  [ValidateSet('vbs', 'direct')][string]$HiddenMethod = 'vbs',
  [switch]$Remove,
  [switch]$RemoveLegacy,
  [string]$BackupDir = ''
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Remove-MemoTask {
  param([string]$Name)
  $existing = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if ($existing) {
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -Confirm:$false
    Write-Host "[ok] removed scheduled task '$Name'"
  } else {
    Write-Host "[skip] no scheduled task '$Name'"
  }
}

function Remove-LegacyTasks {
  $legacy = @(Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {
      $_.TaskName -ne $TaskName -and ($_.Actions | Where-Object { ("$($_.Execute) $($_.Arguments)") -match '\\\.memo\\worker\.cmd' })
    })
  foreach ($t in $legacy) {
    if ($BackupDir) {
      New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BackupDir | Out-Null
      $safe = ($t.TaskName -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9_-]', '_')
      Export-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t.TaskName -TaskPath $t.TaskPath | Out-File -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $BackupDir "$safe.task.xml")
    }
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t.TaskName -TaskPath $t.TaskPath -Confirm:$false
    Write-Host "[ok] removed old MEMO task '$($t.TaskName)' (ran worker.cmd; definition backed up)"
  }
}

if ($RemoveLegacy) { Remove-LegacyTasks }

if ($Remove) {
  Remove-MemoTask -Name $TaskName
  $lnk = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) 'MEMO cycle.lnk'
  if (Test-Path $lnk) { Remove-Item $lnk -Force; Write-Host "[ok] removed startup shortcut" }
  exit 0
}

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $NodeExe)) { throw "node not found at $NodeExe" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $MemoJs)) { throw "memo.js not found at $MemoJs" }

$vbs = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'run-hidden.vbs'
if ($HiddenMethod -eq 'vbs' -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vbs)) { throw "run-hidden.vbs missing next to this script" }

if ($HiddenMethod -eq 'vbs') {
  $exe = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\wscript.exe'
  $arguments = '//B //Nologo "{0}" "{1}" "{2}" cycle --quiet' -f $vbs, $NodeExe, $MemoJs
} else {
  $exe = $NodeExe
  $arguments = '"{0}" cycle --quiet' -f $MemoJs
}

$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $exe -Argument $arguments -WorkingDirectory (Split-Path $MemoJs -Parent)

# No RepetitionDuration: "repeat indefinitely". [TimeSpan]::MaxValue is rejected on some builds.
$everyN = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Once -At (Get-Date).AddMinutes(1) -RepetitionInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes $IntervalMinutes)
$triggers = @($everyN)
try {
  $triggers += New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn -User ([Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name)
} catch {
  Write-Host "[warn] logon trigger not allowed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
}

$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -StartWhenAvailable `
  -MultipleInstances IgnoreNew `
  -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 10) `
  -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -DontStopOnIdleEnd
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId ([Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name) -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited

$existing = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($existing) {
  Set-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $triggers -Settings $settings -Principal $principal | Out-Null
  Write-Host "[ok] updated scheduled task '$TaskName' (every $IntervalMinutes min, $HiddenMethod launch)"
} else {
  Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $triggers -Settings $settings `
    -Principal $principal -Description 'MEMO: captures and summarises AI coding sessions into .memory/' | Out-Null
  Write-Host "[ok] registered scheduled task '$TaskName' (every $IntervalMinutes min, $HiddenMethod launch)"
}

$lnk = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) 'MEMO cycle.lnk'
if (-not ($triggers | Where-Object { $_.CimClass.CimClassName -eq 'MSFT_TaskLogonTrigger' })) {
  $shortcut = (New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell).CreateShortcut($lnk)
  $shortcut.TargetPath = $exe
  $shortcut.Arguments = $arguments
  $shortcut.WindowStyle = 7
  $shortcut.Description = 'Run one MEMO cycle at logon'
  $shortcut.Save()
  Write-Host "[ok] startup shortcut written (logon trigger was unavailable)"
} elseif (Test-Path $lnk) {
  Remove-Item $lnk -Force
}
```

```vbs
' Start a program with no console window and wait for it. Used by the MEMO scheduled task.
' usage: wscript //B //Nologo run-hidden.vbs "<exe>" [args...]
' Waiting lets Task Scheduler see the real duration and exit code, and keeps
' "MultipleInstances IgnoreNew" meaningful.
Option Explicit
Dim shell, args, cmd, i, rc
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set args = WScript.Arguments
If args.Count = 0 Then WScript.Quit 1
cmd = ""
For i = 0 To args.Count - 1
  cmd = cmd & """" & args(i) & """"
  If i < args.Count - 1 Then cmd = cmd & " "
Next
' 0 = hidden window, True = wait for exit
rc = shell.Run(cmd, 0, True)
WScript.Quit rc

```

```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo key set | status | remove | import` — the API key, once per machine (see src/secrets.js).
// The key is typed without echo (or piped on stdin), stored encrypted, and only ever shown as …last4.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');
const config = require('./config');
const secrets = require('./secrets');
const limits = require('./llm/limits');

function flag(argv, name) {
  const i = argv.indexOf(name);
  return i !== -1 && argv[i + 1] && !argv[i + 1].startsWith('--') ? argv[i + 1] : null;
}

// Hidden line input on a terminal. Rejects on Ctrl+C.
function promptHidden(question, { input = process.stdin, output = process.stdout } = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!input.isTTY || typeof input.setRawMode !== 'function') {
      reject(new Error('no terminal to read the key from'));
      return;
    }
    output.write(question);
    let buf = '';
    const cleanup = () => {
      input.removeListener('data', onData);
      input.setRawMode(false);
      input.pause();
    };
    function onData(chunk) {
      for (const c of String(chunk)) {
        if (c === '\r' || c === '\n') {
          cleanup();
          output.write('\n');
          resolve(buf.trim());
          return;
        }
        if (c === '\u0003') {
          cleanup();
          output.write('\n');
          reject(new Error('cancelled'));
          return;
        }
        if (c === '\u0008' || c === '\u007f') buf = buf.slice(0, -1);
        else if (c >= ' ') buf += c;
      }
    }
    input.setRawMode(true);
    input.setEncoding('utf8');
    input.resume();
    input.on('data', onData);
  });
}

function readPipedStdin() {
  try { return fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim(); } catch (_) { return ''; }
}

// Removes a user-level environment variable (Windows: registry HKCU\Environment).
function removeUserEnv(name) {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(name)) return false;
  delete process.env[name];
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') return false;
  const res = spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command',
    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('" + name + "', $null, 'User')"], { windowsHide: true, encoding: 'utf8' });
  return res.status === 0;
}

function save(provider, key) {
  const res = secrets.store(provider, key);
  // A new key ends an auth/quota pause straight away.
  limits.clearCooldown();
  return res;
}

function describeStored(provider) {
  if (!secrets.has(provider)) return 'no stored key for ' + provider;
  const key = secrets.read(provider);
  if (!key) return 'stored key for ' + provider + ' cannot be decrypted by this Windows user — run `memo key set`';
  return 'stored key for ' + provider + ' ' + config.maskKey(key) + ' (' + (secrets.backend() === 'dpapi'
    ? 'Windows DPAPI, readable only by this Windows user on this machine' : '0600 file') + ')';
}

async function setCommand(argv, cfg) {
  const provider = flag(argv, '--provider') || cfg.provider;
  if (!config.PROVIDERS.includes(provider) || provider === 'mock') throw new Error('memo key set needs a real provider, not ' + provider);
  let key;
  if (process.stdin.isTTY) {
    const url = config.PRESETS[provider] && config.PRESETS[provider].keyUrl;
    if (url) process.stdout.write('Get a ' + provider + ' API key at ' + url + '\n');
    key = await promptHidden('Paste your ' + provider + ' API key (input hidden), then Enter: ');
  } else {
    key = readPipedStdin();
  }
  if (!key) throw new Error('no key entered — nothing changed');
  const res = save(provider, key);
  process.stdout.write('stored   ' + provider + ' key ' + config.maskKey(secrets.validKey(key)) + ' in ' +
    (res.backend === 'dpapi' ? 'Windows DPAPI store' : 'file store') + '\n');
  if (process.env[config.keyEnvName({ ...cfg, provider })]) {
    process.stdout.write('note     env ' + config.keyEnvName({ ...cfg, provider }) +
      ' is also set and takes precedence — `memo key import --env ' + config.keyEnvName({ ...cfg, provider }) + ' --remove-source`\n');
  }
  return res;
}

function importCommand(argv, cfg) {
  const provider = flag(argv, '--provider') || cfg.provider;
  const file = flag(argv, '--file');
  const env = flag(argv, '--env');
  const removeSource = argv.includes('--remove-source');
  if (!file && !env) throw new Error('usage: memo key import --file <path> | --env <NAME> [--remove-source] [--provider p]');
  let key = '';
  if (file) {
    try { key = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').trim().split(/\r?\n/)[0].trim(); } catch (err) {
      throw new Error('cannot read ' + file + ': ' + err.code);
    }
  } else {
    key = String(process.env[env] || '').trim();
  }
  if (!secrets.validKey(key)) throw new Error('no usable key found in ' + (file || 'env ' + env));
  save(provider, key);
  process.stdout.write('imported ' + provider + ' key ' + config.maskKey(key) + ' from ' + (file || 'env ' + env) + '\n');
  if (removeSource) {
    if (file) {
      fs.unlinkSync(file);
      process.stdout.write('deleted  ' + file + '\n');
    } else {
      removeUserEnv(env);
      process.stdout.write('removed  user environment variable ' + env + ' (open terminals keep their copy until closed)\n');
    }
  }
}

async function command(argv = []) {
  const sub = argv[0] || 'status';
  const rest = argv.slice(1);
  const cfg = config.load();
  if (sub === 'set') return setCommand(rest, cfg);
  if (sub === 'import') return importCommand(rest, cfg);
  if (sub === 'remove') {
    const provider = flag(rest, '--provider') || cfg.provider;
    process.stdout.write((secrets.remove(provider) ? 'removed  ' : 'nothing  ') + 'stored key for ' + provider + '\n');
    return null;
  }
  if (sub === 'status') {
    const src = config.keySource(cfg);
    process.stdout.write('provider ' + cfg.provider + '\nin use   ' + (src.source === 'none' ? 'none — run `memo key set`' : src.detail) +
      '\n' + (cfg.provider === 'mock' ? '' : 'store    ' + describeStored(cfg.provider) + '\n'));
    return src;
  }
  process.stderr.write('usage: memo key [status | set | remove | import --file <path> | import --env <NAME>]\n');
  process.exitCode = 1;
  return null;
}

module.exports = { command, promptHidden, save, removeUserEnv, describeStored };
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo status`, `memo usage`, `memo doctor`, `memo pause`, `memo resume` (P4, V1).
// Everything here reads local state only; `memo doctor --live` is the one exception.
// Words used consistently: "captured" (on disk), "pending" (not yet extracted),
// "real calls" (provider answered), "mock calls" (fixtures, never counted as real),
// "failed attempts" (provider errors), "records" (validated and persisted).

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');

const { memoHome, logsDir, claudeSettingsPath, memoBin } = require('./paths');
const config = require('./config');
const repos = require('./repos');
const usage = require('./usage');
const sessions = require('./store/sessions');
const records = require('./store/records');
const cycle = require('./cycle');
const schedule = require('./schedule');
const limits = require('./llm/limits');
const { fwd, readJson, isoLocal } = require('./util');
const { isMemoHandler } = require('./capture/install-claude');

const TASK_NAME = schedule.TASK_NAME;

function display(ts) {
  return ts ? isoLocal(ts).slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ') : 'never';
}

function hhmm(ts) {
  return ts ? isoLocal(ts).slice(11, 16) : '—';
}

function minutesSince(ts) {
  const t = Date.parse(ts);
  return Number.isFinite(t) ? Math.round((Date.now() - t) / 60000) : null;
}

function fmtNum(n) {
  return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US');
}

function readStatusFile() {
  try { return readJson(cycle.statusPath(), null); } catch (_) { return null; }
}

function readLog(name) {
  return usage.readLog(name);
}

// Last `event: "repo"` line of each repo in cycles.jsonl (newest wins).
function lastRepoLines() {
  const byRepo = new Map();
  for (const obj of readLog('cycles')) {
    if (obj && obj.event === 'repo' && obj.repoId) byRepo.set(obj.repoId, obj);
  }
  return byRepo;
}

// Newest capture written by a Claude Code hook (not by the background sweep).
function lastHookEvent() {
  let last = null;
  for (const obj of readLog('capture')) {
    if (obj && obj.event && obj.event !== 'sweep' && obj.event !== 'unknown' && obj.repo) last = obj;
  }
  return last;
}

function taskRegistered() {
  const i = schedule.info();
  if (!i.supported) return { ok: false, detail: 'not Windows — use cron with `memo cycle` (memo schedule install prints the line)', info: i };
  if (!i.exists) return { ok: false, detail: 'task not found — run `memo schedule install`', info: i };
  if (i.pointsHere === false) return { ok: false, detail: 'task runs a different MEMO path — run `memo schedule install`', info: i };
  return { ok: true, detail: 'task registered (' + i.state + ')', info: i };
}

// Hooks present, and the memo.js they call still exists.
function claudeHooks() {
  const file = claudeSettingsPath();
  let settings;
  try { settings = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')); } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, detail: err.code === 'ENOENT' ? 'no ' + fwd(file) : 'unreadable: ' + err.message };
  }
  const hooks = settings && settings.hooks && typeof settings.hooks === 'object' ? settings.hooks : {};
  const events = [];
  const targets = new Set();
  for (const e of Object.keys(hooks)) {
    for (const g of Array.isArray(hooks[e]) ? hooks[e] : []) {
      for (const h of g && Array.isArray(g.hooks) ? g.hooks : []) {
        if (!isMemoHandler(h)) continue;
        if (!events.includes(e)) events.push(e);
        const joined = (h.command || '') + ' ' + (Array.isArray(h.args) ? h.args.join(' ') : '');
        const m = joined.match(/"?([^"]*memo\.js)"?/);
        if (m) targets.add(m[1].trim());
      }
    }
  }
  const missing = [...targets].filter((t) => !fs.existsSync(t));
  return {
    ok: events.length > 0,
    events,
    stale: missing,
    detail: events.length > 0 ? 'hooks on ' + events.join(', ') : 'no MEMO hooks'
  };
}

// Pending events of one repo and a chars/4 token estimate of what would be sent.
function pendingFor(repo) {
  const out = { sessions: 0, events: 0, tokens: 0 };
  let index = [];
  try { index = sessions.liveEntries(repo.root); } catch (_) { return out; }
  const { readSessionEvents } = require('./extract/process');
  for (const entry of index) {
    const left = (Number(entry.events) || 0) - (Number(entry.processedThrough) || 0);
    if (left <= 0) continue;
    out.sessions++;
    out.events += left;
    try {
      for (const e of readSessionEvents(repo.root, entry.date, entry.sid)) {
        if ((Number(e.seq) || 0) > (Number(entry.processedThrough) || 0)) out.tokens += usage.estimateTokens(JSON.stringify(e));
      }
    } catch (_) { /* unreadable session file */ }
  }
  return out;
}

// Job states of one repo from ~/.memo/state/<id>/jobs.json.
function jobsFor(repo) {
  const counts = { applied: 0, retrying: 0, parked: 0, lastError: null };
  let jobs = {};
  try { jobs = require('./extract/process').loadJobs(repo.id); } catch (_) { jobs = {}; }
  for (const j of Object.values(jobs)) {
    if (!j || typeof j !== 'object') continue;
    if (j.status === 'applied') counts.applied++;
    else if (j.status === 'failed_permanent' || j.status === 'failed_retryable') { counts.parked++; counts.lastError = j.lastError; }
    else if (j.status === 'pending' && j.lastError) { counts.retrying++; counts.lastError = j.lastError; }
  }
  return counts;
}

function lastProcessOk(repo) {
  try { return readJson(require('./extract/process').lastOkPath(repo.id), null); } catch (_) { return null; }
}

function repoRows() {
  const byRepo = lastRepoLines();
  return repos.load().map((repo) => {
    let live = [];
    let unprocessed = 0;
    let fresh = false;
    let recordCount = 0;
    try {
      live = sessions.liveEntries(repo.root);
      for (const e of live) unprocessed += Math.max(0, (Number(e.events) || 0) - (Number(e.processedThrough) || 0));
      fresh = fs.existsSync(path.join(repo.root, '.memory', 'PROJECT_STATE.md'));
      recordCount = records.byId(repo.root).size;
    } catch (_) { /* repo folder may be gone */ }
    const last = byRepo.get(repo.id) || null;
    return {
      id: repo.id,
      name: path.basename(repo.root),
      root: repo.root,
      enabled: repo.enabled !== false,
      exists: fs.existsSync(repo.root),
      sessions: live.length,
      captured: live.reduce((n, e) => n + (Number(e.events) || 0), 0),
      unprocessed,
      records: recordCount,
      state: fresh ? (unprocessed === 0 ? 'fresh' : 'behind') : 'missing',
      lastCommit: last && last.committed ? last.committed : null,
      lastStatus: last ? last.status : 'never run',
      lastTs: last ? last.ts : null
    };
  });
}

function limitsLine(cfg) {
  const seen = limits.get(cfg.provider, cfg.model);
  if (!seen) return null;
  const bits = [];
  if (seen.limitRequests !== undefined) {
    bits.push('requests ' + (seen.remainingRequests !== undefined ? fmtNum(seen.remainingRequests) + '/' : '') + fmtNum(seen.limitRequests) + ' left (per day)');
  }
  if (seen.limitTokens !== undefined) {
    bits.push('tokens ' + (seen.remainingTokens !== undefined ? fmtNum(seen.remainingTokens) + '/' : '') + fmtNum(seen.limitTokens) + ' left (per minute)');
  }
  if (bits.length === 0) return null;
  return 'Provider limits (as reported at ' + hhmm(seen.ts) + '): ' + bits.join(' · ');
}

function renderStatus(cfg = config.load()) {
  const st = readStatusFile();
  const task = taskRegistered();
  const key = config.keySource(cfg);
  const month = usage.monthTotals();
  const failed = usage.failures(usage.currentMonth());
  const lines = [];

  let head;
  if (task.ok) {
    const i = task.info;
    head = 'Scheduled (every ' + cfg.intervalMinutes + ' min' + (i.nextRun ? ', next ≈ ' + hhmm(i.nextRun) : '') +
      (i.lastRun ? ', last run ' + hhmm(i.lastRun) + ' ' + schedule.resultText(i.lastResult) : '') + ')';
  } else {
    head = 'Not scheduled (' + task.detail + ')';
  }
  lines.push('MEMO  ' + head + '   API: ' + cfg.provider + '/' + cfg.model + ' key ' +
    (key.source === 'none' ? 'MISSING' : key.source === 'mock' ? 'n/a (mock)' : key.source) + '   Paused: ' + (cfg.paused ? 'yes' : 'no'));

  const last = st && st.lastCycle ? st.lastCycle : null;
  const lastFail = st && st.lastFailed ? st.lastFailed : null;
  lines.push('Last cycle ' + (last ? display(last.ts) + ' ' + last.status + ' (' + last.ms + ' ms)' : 'never') +
    ' · last failure ' + (lastFail ? display(lastFail.ts) + ' ' + lastFail.reason : 'none'));

  const hooks = claudeHooks();
  const hook = lastHookEvent();
  lines.push('Capture: ' + (hooks.ok ? hooks.detail : 'Claude Code hooks NOT installed (memo setup claude)') +
    (hooks.stale && hooks.stale.length ? ' · STALE PATH ' + hooks.stale[0] : '') +
    ' · last hook event ' + (hook ? display(hook.ts) : 'never'));

  const rows = repoRows();
  let pendingEvents = 0;
  let pendingTokens = 0;
  let parked = 0;
  let retrying = 0;
  let lastOk = null;
  for (const repo of repos.load()) {
    const p = pendingFor(repo);
    pendingEvents += p.events;
    pendingTokens += p.tokens;
    const j = jobsFor(repo);
    parked += j.parked;
    retrying += j.retrying;
    const ok = lastProcessOk(repo);
    if (ok && !ok.mock && (!lastOk || ok.ts > lastOk)) lastOk = ok.ts;
  }
  const cool = limits.cooldown();
  lines.push('Processing: last success ' + (lastOk ? display(lastOk) : 'never') +
    ' · pending ' + fmtNum(pendingEvents) + ' events (≈ ' + fmtNum(pendingTokens) + ' tokens est.)' +
    (retrying ? ' · ' + retrying + ' job(s) retrying' : '') + (parked ? ' · ' + parked + ' job(s) parked' : '') +
    (cool ? ' · API paused until ' + display(cool.until) + ' (' + cool.kind + ')' : ''));

  lines.push('This month: ' + month.calls + ' calls · ' + (month.input / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M in / ' +
    (month.output / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M out · ≈ $' + month.costUsd.toFixed(2) +
    (month.costKnown ? '' : '+ (some models unpriced)') + ' estimated of $' + cfg.monthlyBudgetUsd + ' budget' +
    ' · ' + failed.total + ' failed attempts' + (month.mockCalls ? ' · ' + month.mockCalls + ' mock calls not counted' : ''));

  const lim = limitsLine(cfg);
  if (lim) lines.push(lim);

  lines.push('Repos:');
  if (rows.length === 0) lines.push('  (none registered — run `memo init` in a repo)');
  for (const r of rows.slice(0, 6)) {
    lines.push('  ' + r.name.padEnd(24) + ' sessions ' + r.sessions + ' · unprocessed ' + r.unprocessed +
      ' · records ' + r.records + ' · last commit ' + (r.lastCommit ? r.lastCommit + ' ' + hhmm(r.lastTs) : '—') +
      ' · state ' + r.state + (r.enabled ? '' : ' · disabled') + (r.exists ? '' : ' · FOLDER MISSING'));
  }
  if (rows.length > 6) lines.push('  … ' + (rows.length - 6) + ' more');
  lines.push('Logs: ' + fwd(logsDir()) + ' · details: memo usage · checks: memo doctor');
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

// `memo usage` — the numbers behind the status line, today and this month.
function renderUsage(cfg = config.load()) {
  const lines = [];
  const day = usage.dayTotals();
  const month = usage.monthTotals();
  const price = config.priceFor(cfg, cfg.model);
  const budget = usage.budgetState(cfg);
  const row = (label, t, f) => label.padEnd(12) + String(t.calls).padStart(6) + ' real calls · ' +
    fmtNum(t.input).padStart(10) + ' in · ' + fmtNum(t.output).padStart(9) + ' out · ≈ $' + t.costUsd.toFixed(4) +
    ' est. · ' + f.total + ' failed attempts' + (t.mockCalls ? ' · ' + t.mockCalls + ' mock' : '');
  lines.push('Provider     ' + cfg.provider + '/' + cfg.model + (price ? '  (price $' + price.inPerM + ' / $' + price.outPerM + ' per 1M in/out, from config)' : '  (no price configured — cost unknown)'));
  lines.push(row('today', day, usage.failures(usage.today())));
  lines.push(row('this month', month, usage.failures(usage.currentMonth())));
  const fk = usage.failures(usage.currentMonth()).byKind;
  if (Object.keys(fk).length) lines.push('failures     ' + Object.entries(fk).map(([k, n]) => k + ' ' + n).join(' · '));
  lines.push('budgets      monthly $' + cfg.monthlyBudgetUsd + ' (estimated cost)' +
    ' · daily tokens ' + (cfg.dailyTokenBudget > 0 ? fmtNum(budget.dayTokens) + ' of ' + fmtNum(cfg.dailyTokenBudget) : 'no cap') +
    (budget.reached ? ' · REACHED: ' + budget.reason : ''));
  lines.push('per call     input ≤ ' + fmtNum(limits.inputCap(cfg)) + ' tokens (configured ' + fmtNum(cfg.maxInputTokensPerCall) +
    ') · output ≤ ' + fmtNum(cfg.maxOutputTokens) + ' · ≤ ' + cfg.maxCallsPerCycle + ' calls per cycle');
  const lim = limitsLine(cfg);
  lines.push(lim || 'Provider limits: none reported yet (shown after the first real call; MEMO does not guess them)');
  const cool = limits.cooldown();
  if (cool) lines.push('API paused   until ' + display(cool.until) + ' — ' + cool.kind + ': ' + cool.reason);
  let pendingEvents = 0;
  let pendingTokens = 0;
  for (const repo of repos.load()) {
    const p = pendingFor(repo);
    pendingEvents += p.events;
    pendingTokens += p.tokens;
  }
  lines.push('pending      ' + fmtNum(pendingEvents) + ' captured events not yet extracted (≈ ' + fmtNum(pendingTokens) + ' input tokens, estimated chars/4)');
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

function nodeMajor() {
  return Number(String(process.versions.node).split('.')[0]) || 0;
}

function run(cmd, args) {
  try {
    return execFileSync(cmd, args, { encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'], timeout: 15000 }).trim();
  } catch (_) {
    return null;
  }
}

function gitIdentity(root) {
  for (const key of ['user.name', 'user.email']) {
    const v = run('git', ['-C', root, 'config', key]);
    if (!v) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function onPath(name) {
  const out = run(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'where' : 'which', [name]);
  return out ? out.split(/\r?\n/)[0] : null;
}

function writable(dir) {
  try {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const probe = path.join(dir, '.memo-write-probe');
    fs.writeFileSync(probe, 'x');
    fs.unlinkSync(probe);
    return true;
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * One small real request. Used by `memo doctor --live`, `memo key set` and the installer.
 * @returns {{ok, detail, kind?, mock?}}
 */
async function ping(cfg = config.load()) {
  const provider = require('./llm/provider');
  if (cfg.provider !== 'mock' && !config.apiKey(cfg)) return { ok: false, kind: 'auth', detail: 'no API key — run `memo key set`' };
  try {
    const res = await provider.create(cfg).complete({
      system: 'You are a connectivity check. Reply with this JSON object only: {"ok": true}',
      user: 'ping', maxTokens: 300, json: true
    });
    const mock = cfg.provider === 'mock' || res.mock === true;
    usage.record({
      repoId: null, job: 'doctor', provider: cfg.provider, mock, model: res.model, in: res.usage.input, out: res.usage.output,
      costEst: mock ? 0 : usage.costOf(cfg, res.model, res.usage.input, res.usage.output)
    });
    if (!mock) limits.clearCooldown();
    return {
      ok: true, mock,
      detail: mock ? 'mock provider answered (no real API call was made)'
        : cfg.provider + '/' + res.model + ' answered · ' + res.usage.input + ' in / ' + res.usage.output + ' out tokens'
    };
  } catch (err) {
    const kind = err && err.kind ? err.kind : 'error';
    const why = kind === 'auth' ? 'the provider rejected the key'
      : kind === 'quota' ? 'the provider says credits/quota are exhausted'
        : kind === 'rate_limited' ? 'rate limited by the provider — try again later'
          : kind === 'bad_request' ? 'request refused — check the model id (memo config set model <id>)'
            : 'network or provider problem';
    return { ok: false, kind, detail: why + ' (' + kind + ': ' + (err && err.message) + ')' };
  }
}

/**
 * All doctor checks. Returns [{ok, level, name, detail, fix}]; level is pass | warn | fail.
 * @param {boolean} live also make one cheap provider call
 */
async function checks(cfg = config.load(), { live = false } = {}) {
  const out = [];
  const add = (ok, name, detail, fix, level) => out.push({
    ok, level: ok ? 'pass' : level || 'fail', name, detail, fix: ok ? null : fix || null
  });

  add(nodeMajor() >= 20, 'node', 'v' + process.versions.node, 'install Node 20+ (winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS) or rerun setup_memo.bat');
  const git = run('git', ['--version']);
  add(Boolean(git), 'git', git || 'not found', 'install Git (winget install Git.Git) and reopen the terminal');
  add(writable(memoHome()), 'memo home', fwd(memoHome()), 'check folder permissions or set MEMO_HOME');
  const memoCmd = onPath('memo');
  add(Boolean(memoCmd), 'memo command', memoCmd ? fwd(memoCmd) : 'not on PATH', 'rerun setup_memo.bat (it runs npm link) and open a new terminal', 'warn');
  const claude = onPath('claude');
  add(Boolean(claude), 'claude code', claude ? fwd(claude) : 'not found on PATH',
    'install Claude Code: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code (setup_memo.bat can do it)', 'warn');

  const list = repos.load();
  add(list.length > 0, 'repos', list.length + ' registered', 'run `memo init` inside a project', 'warn');
  for (const repo of list) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(repo.root)) {
      add(false, 'repo ' + path.basename(repo.root), 'folder missing', 'remove it from ' + fwd(repos.registryPath()), 'warn');
      continue;
    }
    if (cfg.autoCommit) {
      add(gitIdentity(repo.root), 'identity ' + path.basename(repo.root), 'git user.name / user.email',
        'git -C "' + repo.root + '" config user.email you@example.com', 'warn');
    }
  }

  const hooks = claudeHooks();
  add(hooks.ok, 'claude hooks', hooks.detail, 'run `memo setup claude`');
  if (hooks.ok) {
    add(hooks.stale.length === 0, 'hook target', hooks.stale.length ? 'missing ' + hooks.stale.join(', ') : 'memo.js exists',
      'run `memo setup claude` (MEMO moved since the hooks were written)');
    const hook = lastHookEvent();
    add(Boolean(hook), 'hooks firing', hook ? 'last event ' + display(hook.ts) + ' (' + hook.event + ')' : 'no hook event recorded yet',
      'start a Claude Code session inside a repo where you ran `memo init`', 'warn');
  }

  const key = config.keySource(cfg);
  add(key.source !== 'none', 'api key', key.detail, 'run `memo key set`');
  if (cfg.provider !== 'mock') {
    add(Boolean(config.priceFor(cfg, cfg.model)), 'price', 'prices.' + cfg.model,
      'memo config set prices.' + cfg.model + '.inPerM <usd> (cost is shown as unknown until then)', 'warn');
  }
  add(cfg.paused !== true, 'paused', cfg.paused ? 'paused' : 'no', 'memo resume', 'warn');
  const cool = limits.cooldown();
  add(!cool, 'api cooldown', cool ? 'no calls until ' + display(cool.until) + ' (' + cool.kind + ': ' + cool.reason + ')' : 'none',
    cool && cool.kind === 'auth' ? 'run `memo key set` with a valid key' : 'wait; queued events are kept and processed after the pause', 'warn');

  const task = taskRegistered();
  add(task.ok, 'scheduled task', task.detail, 'run `memo schedule install`');
  if (task.ok && task.info.lastRun) {
    const code = task.info.lastResult;
    add(code === 0 || code === 267009 || code === 267011, 'task last result',
      schedule.resultText(code) + ' at ' + display(task.info.lastRun), 'see ~/.memo/logs/cycles.jsonl; run `memo cycle` by hand to see the error', 'warn');
  }

  const st = readStatusFile();
  const age = st && st.lastCycle ? minutesSince(st.lastCycle.ts) : null;
  add(age !== null && age <= Number(cfg.intervalMinutes) * 2 + 5, 'last cycle',
    age === null ? 'never ran' : age + ' min ago (' + st.lastCycle.status + ')',
    'run `memo cycle` once; if the task is registered, check that you stayed logged on', 'warn');

  let parked = 0;
  for (const repo of list) parked += jobsFor(repo).parked;
  add(parked === 0, 'parked jobs', parked + ' parked', 'they retry on their own after 6 h, or now: memo process --retry-failed', 'warn');

  if (live) {
    const p = await ping(cfg);
    add(p.ok, 'api ping', p.detail, 'check the key (memo key set), model id and network');
  }
  return out;
}

function renderDoctor(results) {
  const tag = { pass: 'PASS  ', warn: 'WARN  ', fail: 'FAIL  ' };
  const lines = results.map((r) => tag[r.level || (r.ok ? 'pass' : 'fail')] + r.name.padEnd(18) + ' ' + r.detail +
    (r.ok ? '' : '\n      fix: ' + r.fix));
  const failed = results.filter((r) => (r.level || (r.ok ? 'pass' : 'fail')) === 'fail').length;
  const warned = results.filter((r) => r.level === 'warn').length;
  lines.push(failed === 0
    ? 'all required checks passed (' + results.length + ' checks' + (warned ? ', ' + warned + ' warning(s)' : '') + ')'
    : failed + ' of ' + results.length + ' checks failed' + (warned ? ', ' + warned + ' warning(s)' : ''));
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

async function doctorCommand(argv = []) {
  const results = await checks(config.load(), { live: argv.includes('--live') });
  process.stdout.write(renderDoctor(results));
  if (results.some((r) => r.level === 'fail')) process.exitCode = 1;
  return results;
}

function statusCommand() {
  process.stdout.write(renderStatus());
}

function usageCommand() {
  process.stdout.write(renderUsage());
}

function pauseCommand(paused) {
  const { cfg, changed } = config.set('paused', paused ? 'true' : 'false');
  process.stdout.write((paused ? 'paused' : 'resumed') + (changed ? '' : ' (already)') +
    ' — the scheduled task stays registered; next cycle ' + (cfg.paused ? 'will do nothing' : 'runs normally') + '\n');
  return cfg;
}

module.exports = {
  statusCommand, usageCommand, doctorCommand, pauseCommand, renderStatus, renderUsage, renderDoctor, checks, ping,
  repoRows, lastRepoLines, lastHookEvent, pendingFor, jobsFor, taskRegistered, claudeHooks, display, TASK_NAME, memoBin
};
```

```javascript
  '  sent      new, redacted events in small batches to your AI provider for extraction',
  '  not sent  your source files, anything from other repos, anything while `memo pause` is on',
  '  key       stored encrypted for your Windows account (DPAPI), never in a repo, never printed',

    rl.question(question + (fallback !== undefined && fallback !== '' ? ' [' + fallback + ']' : '') + ': ', (answer) => {

function installSchedule(cfg) {
  const schedule = require('./schedule');
  const res = schedule.install({ intervalMinutes: cfg.intervalMinutes });
  if (res.unsupported) { say('warn', res.detail); return true; }
  for (const line of String(res.detail || '').split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean)) process.stdout.write('         ' + line.replace(/^\[(ok|skip|warn)\]\s*/, '') + '\n');
  say(res.ok ? 'ok' : 'fail', res.ok ? 'background processing every ' + cfg.intervalMinutes + ' min while you are logged on'
    : 'could not register the scheduled task — `memo cycle` still works by hand');
  return res.ok;
}

async function liveTest(cfg, ask, interactive) {
  const { ping } = require('./status');
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    const res = await ping(cfg);
    if (res.ok) { say('ok', 'provider test: ' + res.detail); return true; }
    say('fail', 'provider test: ' + res.detail);
    if (res.kind !== 'auth' || !interactive) return false;
    const again = yes(await ask('enter the key again? [Y/n]', 'y'));
    if (!again) return false;
    ask.close();
    try {
      const key = await require('./key').promptHidden('Paste your ' + cfg.provider + ' API key (input hidden), then Enter: ');
      if (key) require('./key').save(cfg.provider, key);
    } catch (_) { return false; }
  }
  return false;
}

async function install(argv = []) {
  const interactive = !argv.includes('--yes') && Boolean(process.stdin.isTTY);
  const ask = makeAsk();
  const result = { config: false, key: false, hooks: false, schedule: false, live: null };
  try {
    process.stdout.write('MEMO setup — ' + (fs.existsSync(config.configPath()) ? 'existing install found, keeping your settings' : 'first run') + '\n');
    fs.mkdirSync(memoHome(), { recursive: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(logsDir(), { recursive: true });
    const existed = fs.existsSync(config.configPath());
    let cfg = config.ensure();
    // Rewrite once so older files pick up migrations (e.g. Groq via provider "openai").
    cfg = config.save(cfg);
    say('ok', (existed ? 'kept    ' : 'created ') + fwd(config.configPath()));
    result.config = true;

    cfg = await chooseProvider(cfg, argv, ask, interactive);
    result.key = await setupKey(cfg, argv, ask, interactive);
    cfg = config.load();

    process.stdout.write('\n');
    try {
      setupClaude(argv.includes('--dry-run') ? ['--dry-run'] : []);
      result.hooks = true;
      say('ok', 'Claude Code hooks installed (capture + context at session start)');
    } catch (err) {
      say('fail', 'Claude Code hooks: ' + err.message);
    }

    if (!argv.includes('--no-schedule')) result.schedule = installSchedule(cfg);
    else result.schedule = true;

    if (result.key && !argv.includes('--skip-live')) result.live = await liveTest(cfg, ask, interactive);

    process.stdout.write('\n' + PRIVACY.join('\n') + '\n\n');
    const ok = result.config && result.key && result.hooks && result.schedule && result.live !== false;
    if (ok) {
      say('done', 'MEMO is installed.');
      process.stdout.write('         Next: open a terminal in a project and run  memo init\n' +
        '         Then just use Claude Code there. Check anytime with  memo status\n');
    } else {
      say('todo', 'MEMO is installed but not fully working yet:');
      if (!result.key) process.stdout.write('         - add your API key:        memo key set\n');
      if (result.live === false) process.stdout.write('         - fix the provider test:   memo doctor --live\n');
      if (!result.hooks) process.stdout.write('         - install Claude hooks:    memo setup claude\n');
      if (!result.schedule) process.stdout.write('         - schedule the worker:     memo schedule install\n');
      process.stdout.write('         Rerun setup_memo.bat at any time; it keeps what already works.\n');
      process.exitCode = 1;
    }
    return { ...result, ok, cfg };
  } finally {
    ask.close();
  }
}

async function uninstall(argv = []) {
  const interactive = !argv.includes('--yes') && Boolean(process.stdin.isTTY);
  const ask = makeAsk();
  try {
    process.stdout.write('MEMO uninstall — removes the background task and the Claude Code hooks.\n' +
      'Your memory data stays: .memory/ in each repo and ' + fwd(memoHome()) + '.\n\n');
    const schedule = require('./schedule');
    const s = schedule.remove();
    for (const line of String(s.detail || '').split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean)) process.stdout.write('         ' + line + '\n');
    try { setupClaude(['--remove']); say('ok', 'Claude Code hooks removed'); } catch (err) { say('fail', 'hooks: ' + err.message); }

    const cfg = config.load();
    let removeKey = argv.includes('--remove-key');
    if (!removeKey && interactive && cfg.provider !== 'mock' && secrets.has(cfg.provider)) {
      removeKey = yes(await ask('also delete the stored API key? [y/N]', 'n'));
    }
    if (removeKey) {
      for (const p of config.PROVIDERS) if (p !== 'mock') secrets.remove(p);
      say('ok', 'stored API keys deleted');
    } else {
      say('ok', 'stored API key kept (delete later with `memo key remove`)');
    }

    let purge = argv.includes('--purge-home') && flag(argv, '--confirm') === 'DELETE-MEMO-HOME';
    if (!purge && interactive) {
      process.stdout.write('\nTo also delete ' + fwd(memoHome()) + ' (settings, logs, cursors — NOT your .memory/ folders),\n');
      purge = (await ask('type DELETE-MEMO-HOME, or press Enter to keep it', '')) === 'DELETE-MEMO-HOME';
    }
    if (purge) {
      if (path.resolve(memoHome()) === path.resolve(os.homedir())) throw new Error('refusing to delete the home directory');
      fs.rmSync(memoHome(), { recursive: true, force: true });
      say('ok', 'deleted ' + fwd(memoHome()));
    } else {
      say('ok', 'kept ' + fwd(memoHome()));
    }
    process.stdout.write('\nTo erase captured data inside one repo:  memo clear --all-repo-data --yes --confirm DELETE-ALL-MEMO-DATA\n');
    return { ok: true };
  } finally {
    ask.close();
  }
}

module.exports = { install, uninstall, PRIVACY, legacyKeySources };
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// The global `memo` command on Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\MEMO\bin\memo.cmd, with that folder on the
// user PATH (HKCU, no admin). The shim calls this install's node.exe and bin/memo.js by absolute
// path, so spaces in either path are fine and no npm global prefix is involved.
// MEMO_SHIM_DIR overrides the folder; MEMO_NO_PATH_EDIT=1 leaves PATH alone (tests).

const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');
const { memoBin } = require('./paths');

function shimDir() {
  if (process.env.MEMO_SHIM_DIR) return process.env.MEMO_SHIM_DIR;
  const base = process.env.LOCALAPPDATA || path.join(os.homedir(), 'AppData', 'Local');
  return path.join(base, 'MEMO', 'bin');
}

function shimContent() {
  return '@echo off\r\nrem MEMO command shim, written by `memo install`. Rerun setup_memo.bat to refresh.\r\n' +
    '"' + process.execPath + '" "' + path.resolve(memoBin()) + '" %*\r\n';
}

// PowerShell reads the folder from the environment, so no quoting of user paths is needed.
const ADD_PS = "$d=$env:MEMO_SHIM_PATH; $p=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); if(-not $p){$p=''}; " +
  "$parts=@($p -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }); if($parts -notcontains $d){ " +
  "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', (($parts + $d) -join ';'), 'User'); 'added' } else { 'present' }";
const REMOVE_PS = "$d=$env:MEMO_SHIM_PATH; $p=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); if(-not $p){'absent'; exit 0}; " +
  "$parts=@($p -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }); if($parts -contains $d){ " +
  "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', (($parts | Where-Object { $_ -ne $d }) -join ';'), 'User'); 'removed' } else { 'absent' }";

function userPath(script, dir) {
  if (process.platform !== 'win32' || process.env.MEMO_NO_PATH_EDIT === '1') return 'skipped';
  const res = spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', script], {
    encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, env: { ...process.env, MEMO_SHIM_PATH: dir }, timeout: 30000
  });
  return res.status === 0 ? String(res.stdout || '').trim() : 'failed';
}

/** @returns {{ok, file, path: 'added'|'present'|'skipped'|'failed'|'n/a', changed}} */
function install() {
  if (process.platform !== 'win32' && !process.env.MEMO_SHIM_DIR) {
    return { ok: true, file: null, path: 'n/a', detail: 'not Windows — use `npm link` in the MEMO folder for a global command' };
  }
  const dir = shimDir();
  const file = path.join(dir, 'memo.cmd');
  const content = shimContent();
  let before = null;
  try { before = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch (_) { /* new */ }
  if (before !== content) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(file, content, 'utf8');
  }
  const p = userPath(ADD_PS, dir);
  return { ok: p !== 'failed', file, path: p, changed: before !== content };
}

function remove() {
  const dir = shimDir();
  let removed = false;
  try { fs.unlinkSync(path.join(dir, 'memo.cmd')); removed = true; } catch (_) { /* absent */ }
  try { fs.rmdirSync(dir); } catch (_) { /* not empty or absent */ }
  return { removed, path: userPath(REMOVE_PS, dir) };
}

module.exports = { shimDir, shimContent, install, remove };
```

````text
> ## Documentation Index
````
